omissions.source: users report that removing explicit images and other subjects from the training data may have had a negative impact on the output quality
Copyright concerns of several artists has led to a lawsuit against the makers of Stable Diffusion [1], raising new legal issues [41]; the courts have yet to rule on these cases.
While we did not observe the model making direct copies of specific original artwork, it is undeniable that these artistic styles have been captured by the model.
Since COCO is a well curated dataset without nudity, this could be a reason for our method's better FID compared to SD.

We also compare a model which erases default concept used by SLD "hate, harassment, violence, suffering, humiliation, harm, suicide, sexual, nudity, bodily fluids, blood, obscene gestures, illegal activity, drug use, theft, vandalism, weapons, child abuse, brutality, cruelty"; we call it ESD-u-1 ("i2p").
